title: Senior Manager - Technology Operations Engineering
text:
Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

We are seeking an experienced and technically strong **Senior Manager – Technology Operations Engineering** to lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Application Production Support, and operational excellence for enterprise Contact Center Transformation platforms.

This role will be responsible for ensuring the **end-to-end availability, reliability, performance, scalability, and operational stability** of mission-critical voice platforms, contact center applications, cloud-native services, intelligent voice bots, and AI-powered customer engagement solutions.

The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP), SRE practices, enterprise application support, Five9, Genesys, telephony technologies, full-stack observability, distributed tracing, and incident management** . The role also requires knowledge of emerging technologies, including Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

The Senior Manager will lead engineering teams responsible for 24x7 production support, proactive monitoring, incident resolution, problem management, change management, automation, and continuous reliability improvements across complex, distributed contact center ecosystems.

 

* **Education & Professional Experience:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with **10+ years of experience** in Technology Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, Application Production Support, or Cloud Engineering, including **5+ years in technical leadership or engineering management roles** .

* **Site Reliability Engineering & Application Support:** Extensive hands-on experience in **SRE, enterprise application production support, distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, application performance troubleshooting, service reliability, and 24x7 production operations** , including on-call support and critical incident resolution.

* **Google Cloud Platform (Mandatory):** Strong hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** and cloud-native technologies, including GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Pub/Sub, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, API Gateway, cloud networking, load balancing, and containerized application environments.

* **Contact Center & Telephony Expertise:** Proven experience supporting **Five9, Genesys, or similar enterprise contact center platforms** , with a strong understanding of telephony architecture, SIP, RTP, IVR, ACD, CTI, call routing, intelligent voice bots, and contact center integrations. Experience with SpeechMiner or comparable speech analytics platforms is highly desirable.

* **Full-Stack Observability & Distributed Tracing:** Strong experience with **Grafana, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, centralized logging, application performance monitoring, and cloud observability tools** , including the ability to implement end-to-end monitoring and troubleshoot complex distributed application issues.

* **AI, Agentic AI & MCP Technologies:** Experience or strong working knowledge of **conversational AI, intelligent voice bots, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers** , including AI workflow observability, execution tracing, integration troubleshooting, and operational reliability.

* **Incident, Problem & Change Management:** Demonstrated expertise in **ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management** , including major incident leadership, root cause analysis, production change coordination, escalation management, on-call operations, and continuous service improvement.

* **Database & Application Integration Technologies:** Hands-on experience supporting **NoSQL databases, Google Cloud Firestore, Oracle Database, APIs, middleware, and distributed application architectures** , with strong troubleshooting capabilities across database performance, connectivity, transaction processing, and enterprise integrations.

* **Networking, Infrastructure & Automation:** Strong understanding of **TCP/IP, DNS, HTTPS, SIP/RTP, firewalls, load balancers, traffic routing, cloud networking, Kubernetes, and containerized environments** , along with experience in automation, scripting, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as Python, Bash, or Terraform.

* **Technical Leadership & Operational Excellence:** Proven ability to lead engineering teams, manage complex production environments, collaborate across technology organizations, and drive **SRE maturity, operational automation, observability improvements, incident reduction, service reliability, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous engineering excellence** , supported by strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.
